query:
SELECT EXISTS (
               SELECT 1
               FROM workspace_settings ws,
                    jsonb_array_elements(
                        CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(ws.git_sync->'repositories') = 'array'
                             THEN ws.git_sync->'repositories' END
                    ) r
               WHERE ws.workspace_id = $1
                 AND r->'auto_pull'->'last_synced_sha'->>$3 = $2
           ) AND NOT EXISTS (
               SELECT 1
               FROM workspace_settings ws,
                    jsonb_array_elements(
                        CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(ws.git_sync->'repositories') = 'array'
                             THEN ws.git_sync->'repositories' END
                    ) r
               WHERE ws.workspace_id = $1
                 AND r->'auto_pull'->'last_pull_status'->>'synced_sha' = $2
                 AND NOT EXISTS (
                     SELECT 1 FROM v2_job_completed c
                     WHERE c.id = (r->'auto_pull'->'last_pull_status'->>'job_id')::uuid
                       AND c.status = 'success'
                 )
           ) AND NOT EXISTS (
               SELECT 1
               FROM v2_job_queue q
               JOIN v2_job j ON j.id = q.id
               WHERE q.workspace_id = $1
                 AND j.kind IN ('dependencies', 'flowdependencies', 'appdependencies')
           ) as "ready!"
